page: Amazon Web Services r8idb.large is a memory-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor and an Intel x86_64 processor. The instance provides 2 vCPUs mapped across 1 physical core with 2 threads per core at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz, utilizing dedicated CPU allocation. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Local high-speed ephemeral storage is bundled directly with the instance, consisting of 118 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. Network connectivity operates with a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio and direct attached NVMe storage, r8idb.large is structured for workloads that require fast local disk caching alongside higher memory capacity per core. Common deployment scenarios include in-memory caches, small relational database workloads, transient data processing pipelines, and development or testing environments requiring high-throughput local scratch space.
